notes: Pages opened (3 of 1-5; the 'Bai Di' page is a disambiguation and was not used): Xianyu (state), Zhongshan (state), Northern Di. Wikidata id left null (unreachable). WHAT THIS DOSSIER IS: the Di state of Xianyu from its setting up after 660 to the Wei conquest of the Zhongshan that sat on the same land in 407. The Xianyu page and the Zhongshan page disagree: Xianyu 'conquered' in 489, yet Zhongshan 'lasted about 200 more years' from 506; the Zhongshan page itself says Zhongshan's continuity with Xianyu is challenged. The reconciliation drawn here is that Jin took the Zhending core in 489 while the Tang County state survived; the reviewer may prefer to end Xianyu in 489 and hand 506-407 to a separate Zhongshan-before-Wei dossier. START 660 is a bridge (the page says 'afterwards'); the name is older (Guoyu). The 407 year is the Zhongshan page; the Northern Di page says 406; the earlier ea-01-e report gave the mentions 506-489 as years. The 414 capital at Gu (Duke Wu) is on the Zhongshan page but Gu is not located, so it is not drawn. AREA: no page gives one, so no Cliopatria comparison (no Xianyu row). COUNTERPARTS: Fei, Gu (Di towns, Hebei; Fei destroyed 530, Gu conquered 520) have no dossiers; Lushi (Red Di, destroyed by Jin in 594) and Wuzhong are on the Northern Di page and would be separate Di dossiers (not written, no land on the page). The wei dossier lacks the 407 gain; the jin dossier lacks the 489 gain.
